signIn.title: Moderator sign in
signIn.body: We'll email you a sign-in link. Only moderator accounts can open the console.
signIn.sent: If that address belongs to a Pickld account, a sign-in link is on its way. It works once.
signIn.badLink: That link has expired or was already used. Ask for a new one.

denied.body: You're signed in as {{email}}, which isn't a moderator account. Ask a founder to add the moderator role if you should have access.
